Colleagues,
Nebulon Gives is officially underway. The campaign runs Jan 12–30 across all Nebulon sites, in partnership with United Way.
Even a small contribution—such as $1 per paycheck—adds up quickly when thousands of us participate, supporting programs that strengthen our local communities.
Please take a moment to enroll through the HR portal when you’re ready: https://hrportal.nebulon[.]com/nebulon-gives
Thank you,
Executive Sponsor, Nebulon Gives
